result.reason: The added language provides a professional-and-workmanlike standard, a 90-day software/deliverable conformance warranty, and re-performance, repair, replacement, or refund remedies. However, it does not include the required warranties regarding compliance with laws or absence of malicious code, and it does not clearly provide the fallback 30-day services warranty period. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions. The redline also unnecessarily reorders existing provisions, and the new warranty language appears after the disclaimer while referring to itself as part of Section 9, creating structural ambiguity. Unrelated commercial terms are otherwise substantially preserved.
